subject: Rebook: Redwood POC hands-on orientation + load-test coordination
messages:
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
From: Elena Morris <elena@fluxpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Subject: Interest in a hands-on POC week kickoff (prompt review + load test)

Hi Hannah and Ben,

Thanks for the demo earlier — the team at FluxPay is excited to move towards a short POC week. We'd like a hands-on kickoff where we can: review a set of prompts, walk through routing/policy behavior, and run a light load test to sanity-check throughput.

High-level asks:
- 60–90 minute working session (ideally including 15 min for a short load smoke test)
- Someone from your side to run prompt/routing walkthrough and a solutions engineer for the load run
- We'll provide test prompts and a small dataset (S3 link) and two engineers to join (see below)

Proposed slots from our side: Nov 10 (Wed) 10:00–11:30 PT or Nov 11 (Thu) 14:00–15:30 PT. If neither works, we can be flexible the following week.

Attending from FluxPay:
- Elena Morris — Product (me)
- Samir Patel — Backend Engineer (samir.p@fluxpay.com)
- Maya Lin — Platform/Networking (maya.lin@fluxpay.com)

I can share a short primer and the prompt file. Can you confirm whether Redwood needs network prep (VPC peering) or if you can run the load from your hosted environment?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Product, FluxPay
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:05:12 -0700
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Interest in a hands-on POC week kickoff (prompt review + load test)

Hi Elena — great to hear.

We can absolutely run that type of session. Quick questions so we can set expectations and a short agenda:
- Do you want this to be 60 or 90 minutes? We can compress content if you prefer 60 (prompt review + routing walkthrough + 10–15 min smoke load).
- For the smoke load: what peak concurrency/qps should we simulate and roughly how large is the test dataset (number of prompts)?
- Will FluxPay provide an S3 test bucket or would you prefer we host a temporary dataset on our side? If you want us running load from Hosted, tell us any IP allowlist / firewall constraints.

I have the following open slots on my calendar:
- Nov 12 (Fri) 10:00–11:30 PT (90m)
- Nov 13 (Sat) 14:00–15:30 PT (90m) — I know weekend may be rough; just listing availability

If those don’t work, share a couple of windows next week and we’ll align. I’m attaching a draft POC agenda (POC_Agenda_v1.docx) and a short load-test checklist for planning.

-Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: POC_Agenda_v1.docx)
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:23:55 -0700
From: Elena Morris <elena@fluxpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@fluxpay.com>, Maya Lin <maya.lin@fluxpay.com>
Subject: Re: Interest in a hands-on POC week kickoff (prompt review + load test)

Thanks, Hannah — appreciate the agenda.

Unfortunately our product leadership booked travel for the 12th–13th, so those slots won’t work. Could you do either Nov 17 (Wed) 09:00–10:30 PT or Nov 18 (Thu) 16:00–17:30 PT? If possible we'd prefer a single 60-minute session (we can follow up with a separate deep-dive if needed).

For the smoke load: we plan to simulate ~20 concurrent users (~60 req/s peak) and a dataset of ~1,200 prompts. We’ll provide an S3 bucket and can also open a temporary VPN if needed for any private endpoints. Samir and Maya will be the engineering leads and will share any firewall details.

Attendees reiterated: Samir Patel (backend), Maya Lin (platform).

Thanks — Elena
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:10:04 -0700
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Interest in a hands-on POC week kickoff (prompt review + load test)

Elena — thanks for the details, and noted on the expected concurrency. Good news: a slot opened up on our side this week due to a cancellation. I can do a shortened 60-minute working session in two possible windows:

Option A — Nov 10 (Tue) 13:00–14:00 PT (60m) — earlier than your later suggestions but would allow a quick start
Option B — Nov 17 (Wed) 09:00–10:00 PT (60m) — aligns with one of your preferred slots and fits the 60-min ask

Plan for the 60-min session:
- 0–10 min: quick intros and success criteria
- 10–30 min: prompt review and recommended routing policies (examples + quick edits)
- 30–45 min: hands-on run-through (live requests, KV/prefix caching notes)
- 45–55 min: smoke load test (we run a 10-minute spike to ~60 req/s)
- 55–60 min: next steps and action items

Can you confirm which option you prefer? Also, please have Samir/Maya share the S3 link and any IP allowlist info at least 24 hours before the session. If you prefer Redwood to run the load from Hosted, we’ll need an allowlist for these source IPs: 34.82.12.45, 34.82.12.46.

Attaching the updated agenda (POC_Agenda_v2.docx) and a short loadtest-checklist.txt to make prep easier.

Best,
Hannah
(attachment: POC_Agenda_v2.docx, loadtest-checklist.txt)

Subject: Re: Interest in a hands-on POC week kickoff (prompt review + load test)

Hi Hannah — Nov 17 09:00–10:00 PT works for us.

Samir will share the S3 link by EOD Monday and I’ll follow up with firewall / IP allowlist details. We’re comfortable with the hosted smoke test using the IPs you listed.

Attendees confirmed: Elena Morris, Samir Patel, Maya Lin. Please send a calendar invite and we’ll accept.

Attachment: FluxPay_POC_Primer.pdf (short intro to our product and sample prompts)

See you then — thanks for accommodating the shortened slot.

Best,
Elena
